g.title: {"@rid": "#420:113", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Piles, also known as haemorrhoids, are swollen and enlarged veins in the lower rectum or anus. They may cause rectal bleeding, discomfort, itching, or a lump around the anal region.", "name": "Piles", "id": "815"}

{"@rid": "#420:83", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Rheumatoid arthritis is a chronic autoimmune inflammatory disorder that primarily affects the joints. It commonly causes symmetrical joint pain, swelling, stiffness, and progressive joint damage.", "name": "Rheumatoid Arthritis", "id": "785"}

{"@rid": "#420:84", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Sciatica refers to pain along the distribution of the sciatic nerve, usually caused by irritation or compression of a nerve root in the lower spine. It commonly produces pain radiating from the lower back or buttock into the leg.", "name": "Sciatica", "id": "786"}

{"@rid": "#420:2", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Alopecia is the medical term for hair loss. It can mean small round patches missing from the scalp (alopecia areata), total loss of head hair (alopecia totalis), or loss of all body hair (alopecia universalis).", "name": "Alopecia", "id": "704"}

{"@rid": "#420:105", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "A wound is a disruption or injury to the normal structure and integrity of body tissue, usually involving the skin or underlying tissues. It may result from trauma, surgery, infection, or other pathological processes.", "name": "Wounds", "id": "807"}

{"@rid": "#420:33", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Eczema is a skin disorder characterized by Itching erythema, Scaling, Edema, vesiculation, and Discharge", "name": "Eczema", "id": "735"}

{"@rid": "#420:64", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Obesity is a chronic condition characterized by excessive accumulation of body fat that may adversely affect health.", "name": "Obesity", "id": "766"}

{"@rid": "#420:11", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Bronchial asthma is a long-term lung disease that inflames and narrows the airways. It causes recurring bouts of wheezing, chest tightness, shortness of breath, and coughing.", "name": "Bronchial Asthma", "id": "713"}

{"@rid": "#420:31", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Dysmenorrhea refers to painful menstruation, typically characterized by cramping pain in the lower abdomen during the menstrual period. It may also be accompanied by symptoms such as backache, nausea, or fatigue.", "name": "Dysmenorrhea", "id": "733"}

{"@rid": "#420:71", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Osteoporosis is a skeletal disorder characterized by reduced bone strength and increased susceptibility to fractures. It commonly affects the spine, hip, and wrist.", "name": "Osteoporosis", "id": "773"}

{"@rid": "#420:26", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Diabetes mellitus is a chronic metabolic disorder characterized by elevated blood glucose levels resulting from inadequate insulin production, impaired insulin action, or a combination of both. Persistent hyperglycaemia can lead to complications affecting multiple organs.", "name": "Diabetes Mellitus", "id": "728"}

{"@rid": "#420:32", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Dysuria refers to painful, burning, or uncomfortable urination. It is commonly associated with infections or inflammation of the urinary tract but may occur due to other urinary or genital conditions.", "name": "Dysuria", "id": "734"}

{"@rid": "#420:98", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Ulcerative colitis is a chronic inflammatory bowel disease characterized by inflammation and ulceration of the lining of the colon and rectum. It commonly causes abdominal pain, diarrhoea, rectal bleeding, and urgency.", "name": "Ulcerative Colitis", "id": "800"}

{"@rid": "#420:59", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Migraine is a neurological disorder characterized by recurrent attacks of moderate to severe headache, often accompanied by nausea and sensitivity to light or sound.", "name": "Migraine", "id": "761"}

{"@rid": "#420:86", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Sinusitis is inflammation of the paranasal sinuses, often associated with nasal congestion, facial pressure or pain, nasal discharge, and reduced sense of smell.", "name": "Sinusitis", "id": "788"}

{"@rid": "#420:25", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Depression is a mental health disorder characterized by persistent sadness or low mood, loss of interest or pleasure, and associated emotional, cognitive, behavioural, and physical symptoms that can interfere with daily functioning.", "name": "Depression", "id": "727"}

{"@rid": "#420:42", "@type": "Disease", "@cat": "v", "Description": "Glaucoma is a group of eye disorders characterized by progressive damage to the optic nerve, often associated with elevated intraocular pressure.", "name": "Glaucoma", "id": "744"}
